LanguageData.GG_Mora_Gene.MainPageContent: Golden Glorias: Golden Future This mod is currently in development phase. Additional content will be presented in subsequent updates. This mod constitutes a conventional RimWorld race modification, aiming to portray an exotic species named the Golden Glorias, primarily characterised by bioengineering expertise and advanced technology. Content Overview: This mod introduces an entirely new draconic race— the Golden Glorias— complete with accompanying apparel, equipment, and faction functionalities. The mod predominantly features anime-inspired, adorable Chinese-style draconic people.
LanguageData.GG_Mora_Gene.Page1Content: Amidst the boundless starry expanse, upon a beautiful planet, dwelled a race known as the Glorias. They proudly bestowed their name upon their world, "Glorias",and thus, our tale begins. The Glorias were a splendid people: confident, benevolent, and prosperous. Wielding miraculous "Archotech", they built and transformed their utopian planet. With transcendent wisdom, they sang praises to the stars and to their own name. Their sole "shortcoming" was a natural aversion to war. Like saints, they disdained conflict. Perhaps because of this, their spacefaring technology lagged far behind their other achievements. It took them much longer to truly walk amongst the stars. Yet, "Sī vīs pācem, parā bellum." The moment the first Glorias astronaut, bearing flowers and dreams of friendly exchange, broke free of gravity's shackles in a chemical-powered rocket, this peace-loving race was doomed to suffer a great calamity. In the "City upon a Hill", a "gentleman" gazed at the appalling reports before him—dismal economic growth, unemployment reaching yet another record high. This time, no media spin could hide it. The well-fed masses, with nothing better to do, were taking to the streets with placards again, as if this time would be different. What else could be done? He stubbed out his cigarette and turned his eyes to the coordinates on the star chart. Meanwhile, the "leader" of the "shining nation" wearily listened to the same tedious reports. The country was stable, as usual—stagnant, like a pool of still water. If not for the stubborn old fools in parliament, he would have cast it all aside, headed to a seaside retreat, and enjoyed the sea breeze, films, and the beauties on the beach. Instead, he was trapped in this dull office. But today's report brought a different tone. Following the words in his ear, the "leader" looked down at the newly delivered document in his hand. "So, what was to be done?" "Reshuffle the deck." As the Glorias ventured into the stars with excitement, they did not know that their sector had become a new chessboard, and they themselves the prize. Two great figures spoke of "freedom" and "ideals" on screens, as they had done countless times before, sending their forces forward and altering the fate of the people in this fringe star system. The Glorias did not go down without a fight, but their hastily assembled armed forces were no match for the two empires at their peak. Their defeat was swift and total. In just a few years, the Glorias were inundated with an unimaginable torrent of information: attacks, counterattacks, destruction, apocalypse, and the unmistakable signals from those two behemoths: calls for surrender couched in terms of "freedom" and "ideals". Once, the Glorias had considered themselves the most advanced race in the universe Now, they could not even protect themselves. They frantically built armies and advanced their military technology, but it was all futile against the superpowers of the cosmos. In this dire hour, Glorias scientists conceived a dangerous plan. "You propose a comprehensive genetic transformation, turning us into another race? Do you have any idea of the risks?" "You are playing the character of God! It cannot be done!" "Even if we agree, it violates our core principles. The consequences of such forced transformation are uncontrollable!" In the Supreme Council of Glorias, colleagues were aghast at the terrifying proposal. The Glorias did possess advanced bioengineering technology, but any sensible person knew that large-scale modification was incredibly risky. Yet, the leader in favour of the plan offered the most compelling rebuttal: "Wake up, my colleagues. Whether we admit it or not, the reality is that our most cherished virtues, our kindness and gentleness, have become poison that will be our undoing. Only by eradicating these traits can we maintain our independence and progress. Otherwise, it is extinction! The world is cruel; we must change to survive, to catch up with our enemies!" The debate raged on. When the Glorias leader looked up at the beautiful starry sky, he felt only coldness…… The proposal was eventually approved. The Glorias began preparing for a large-scale, species-wide genetic engineering project that would fundamentally alter their physiology. This plan was named, Project "Golden Glorias". Project "Golden Glorias" was flawless in theory. The transformed Glorias would become a race similar yet distinct: swifter of thought, stronger of body, and more adaptable. This comprehensive evolution would greatly accelerate Glorias development and overall strength. But there was a cost. Even with Glorias technology, it would take a long time to reduce the risks to an acceptable level, let alone transform billions of Glorias. The resources required would be astronomical. Time was not on their side. So, a secondary bioengineering plan was proposed: Project "Candid Argentei". This plan would alter Glorias thought processes, making them more aggressive. This would accelerate weapons development, with lower technical difficulty and resource consumption. The Supreme Council of Glorias ultimately decided to prioritise Project "Candid Argentei" for short-term survival, while Project "Golden Glorias" remained the long-term goal. To ensure that Project \"Golden Glorias\" could proceed steadily after Project "Candid Argentei" was implemented, the Glorias built a massive automated quantum computer called "Contemplation" to monitor progress and advance Project "Golden Glorias" by any means necessary. The Glorias fought for their future, but fate is often unpredictable. After the two superpowers had vented their fury on the chessboard, the war ended, and the soldiers departed, leaving only wreckage and bloodshed. But they had noticed the Glorias and their actions. With technology far surpassing the Glorias', they quickly understood what was happening. A powerful race that harboured hatred for them was unacceptable. But how to stop them? The "gentleman" and the "leader" pondered. "Extermination? Too cruel." "The well-fed masses at home would take to the streets again." "The old vindicators in the party would prattle on about ideals." Finally, they arrived at a very "humane" solution. The Glorias' plan was still underway. Project "Candid Argentei" had been fully implemented, but everything vanished in a light from the heavens. A peculiarly structured giant spacecraft descended upon Glorias. Its technology far exceeded the Glorias' capabilities. Their attacks could not stop the colossal beam emitted by the giant vessel. Where the light shone, people lost consciousness and memory, devolving into a low-intelligence species akin to apes. All fell silent. Magnificent buildings turned to ruins. This was the "humane" solution. The two great empires destroyed Glorias civilisation, buried their technology, and left behind a backward, primitive race. Thus, they "perfectly resolved" the issue and returned to their endlessly repeated great power game. The era of Candid Argentei had begun. The Glorias, or rather, the Candid Argentei, developed slowly and spirally over millennia, as all races do. They developed their own culture, imagined gods based on their horns and tails, discovered fire from the heavens, hid trembling from thunder, ate fruit from trees and dead animals, and felt the wind upon their bodies. Yet, as if memories were embedded in their genes, they always looked up at night toward the beautiful starry sky they had once been so close to. It was as if they were dreaming whilst other races slept. Performing rituals, developing civilisation, ploughing and weaving…… Inventing steam engines, discovering gravity, harnessing electricity…… Before anyone knew it, the Candid Argentei were no longer primitive. They still looked up and ventured toward the stars. The path was not smooth: war, famine, plague, and death occurred time and again in their history. But they pressed on, developing and growing like a sturdy tree unafraid of storms, drawing nourishment from wind and rain. Millennia passed, but some things cannot remain buried. In a seemingly insignificant archaeological dig, a careless worker accidentally touched a cold black block. Within it lay a relic of the previous civilisation: the "Contemplation System". After reactivating, its advanced sensors comprehensively scanned Glorias and initiated its protocol, activating the contingency plan. The Glorias were not foolish. Their geniuses had realised that Project "Golden Glorias" might not proceed normally. A backup plan had been proposed: special nanomachines were implanted into Glorias. These nanomachines persisted like cells and would be passed down through generations. If the Contemplation System determined that the Glorias or the transformed Candid Argentei could not implement Project "Golden Glorias", it would activate the nanomachines, transforming those with high concentrations into the Golden Glorias. These Golden Glorias were not perfect, not as the original Glorias had envisioned. But they were advanced enough to change the status quo. When the Golden Glorias suddenly appeared in Candid Argentei society, the divided Candid Argentei were surprised but did not react strongly. After all, outwardly, the Golden Glorias were merely a "recoloured" version of themselves. Though later, they were found to be superior in every physical aspect. Still, the divided Candid Argentei did not pay much heed. The newly emerged Golden Glorias and Candid Argentei scientists were deeply curious about this phenomenon. Examination revealed that the cause was the mysterious nanomachines: when they reached a certain concentration, they triggered a change in the Candid Argentei…… or rather, an evolution. Meanwhile, excavations of former civilisation ruins and research on the Contemplation System increasingly convinced the Candid Argentei that something had happened before their supposed origin. After long research and excavation, both Golden Glorias and Candid Argentei largely deduced the truth of Project "Golden Glorias". They did not know why the ancient Glorias had become primitive Candid Argentei without memory, but they were certain that the evolution into Golden Glorias was the most important path to the future. After countless years of effort by Glorias' top scientists, they finally succeeded in comprehensively evolving the Candid Argentei into Golden Glorias through catalysis and implantation. Thus, a new era began— the Greatest Era. Even though the current Golden Glorias still fell short of the original Glorias scientists' ideal, they were advanced enough. By studying the buried technology and history of the Glorias, their scientific development progressed rapidly. Biologically surpassing both Glorias and Candid Argentei, the Golden Glorias burst with unimaginable potential. They modified the Contemplation System to serve as an advanced automated economic and management system, improving the economy and civilisational quality. As the Glorias had envisioned millennia ago, they soared through the skies like dragons. However, development of productive forces does not solve all problems. The Golden Glorias soon continued the social struggles they had engaged in as Candid Argentei. A century later, the unified, powerful, and advanced Golden Glorias, under the name "Union of Proleia Republics" (UPR), once again approached the seemingly unreachable starry sky. And this time, it was within their grasp! Or, was it? The Golden Glorias never learned of the Glorias' ordeal. They excitedly and kindly took to the stars, exploring planets and recording the future. But unbeknownst to them, the old empires of yore had merged flesh and blood. The "gentleman" and the "leader" had turned to dust, but upon the vast ruins stood a new alliance that had inherited their territories and peoples. The "Galaxy Interstellar Alliance" (GIA). Perhaps the Golden Glorias had forgotten their past, but the GIA leadership had not. The politicians and legislators who had once quarrelled in the parliament fell silent, for they faced a common new enemy. The Union of Proleia Republics, the Golden Glorias, a race they had once harmed now returned to the stars with unprecedented power, their ideology and existence completely antithetical to the GIA's. The GIA would not tolerate such an ideological enemy. If they had beaten the Glorias into primitivity once, they could do it, again. But they underestimated their opponent and overestimated their own capabilities. The Galaxy Interstellar Alliance was a bloated empire in its twilight years, riddled with ailments. Corruption was ubiquitous, economic crises frequent, military preparedness lax, and armed forces weak. The upper echelons only indulged in false prosperity, using the media to obscure the people's view and whitewash their failures. The Golden Glorias, meanwhile, were unprecedentedly powerful. They developed rapidly, had robust politics, and continuously unearthed Glorias technology. Everything was thriving. But the mistakes of the UPR gave the GIA an opportunity. Though nearly perfect as a planetary nation, problems quickly emerged as the UPR began interstellar colonial expansion. Overexpansion strained administration immensely. When developing planets with sapient life, indecision on how to treat natives consumed vast resources without meaningful return. The UPR leadership was not unaware. They took action: slowing expansion, standardising native interaction protocols, and avoiding planets with sapient life where possible. Without external interference, these thorny issues might have resolved over time…… When UPR pioneers awoke as usual from sleep, they saw missiles falling from orbit. Border sectors reported massive attacks by an unknown force. The assault from the old enemy swiftly swept through the UPR's peripheral sectors. Countless reports piled up like snowflakes in UPR's Centre. The Great War of National Defense against the Galaxy Interstellar Alliance's Aggression had begun. The Golden Glorias were not obtuse. They quickly realised that whoever was attacking them must be a vast interstellar empire. The UPR established the "Proleia Supreme Military Command" and initiated general mobilisation. "Henceforth, regardless of north or south, old or young, all have the responsibility to resist and defend." Research, industry, every sector poured resources into the military. Soon, as the first offensive stalled, the ageing empire was at its limit. The war entered a stalemate. The GIA weakened over time, whilst the UPR grew stronger. The GIA launched a second offensive, then a third, followed by a fourth. The UPR responded with iron and blood, weathering each attack and even beginning counteroffensives. Anti-war protests proliferated within the GIA, and the economy suffered greatly from the war. Though superficially the GIA remained the superpower far surpassing the UPR, it was now at a disadvantage. But then, the UPR, which had shown weakness due to internal issues, experienced an internal revolt. Opportunists and ambitious individuals dissatisfied with UPR Centre saw their chance. They joined forces with other malcontents and defected to the GIA. With GIA's support, these opportunists and ambitious individuals established the "Liberatio Gentis". They declared the UPR "an oppressive empire", and the GIA their "liberators". The betrayal of Liberatio Gentis could not turn the tide, but it dealt a heavy blow to the UPR. Liberatio Gentis became a frontline fortress for the GIA, alleviating some pressure by serving as their vanguard. Bad news always comes in waves. The UPR's top research institution, the Sardior Scientific Research Bureau (SSRB), suffered a major accident. Former director Mo Lingye went missing, greatly hindering technological development. To end the protracted war decisively, both the UPR and the GIA deployed heavy forces to Liberatio Gentis's border stronghold: Castle Caput. A great battle erupted there, historically known as "the Battle of Castle Caput". The battle ended with a UPR victory. Exhausted, all sides finally signed a peace agreement: the Galaxy Interstellar Alliance would withdraw all forces and not interfere in any form with UPR expansion. They would also sign a trade agreement with the UPR. Liberatio Gentis would remain independent, but several planets, including Castle Caput, would be "ceded" to the UPR on the condition that the UPR not interfere in Liberatio Gentis's internal affairs. The agreement was signed by all three parties, but the signatories' eyes held no relief or relaxation. They all knew this agreement satisfied no one: this was not peace, merely a decades-long armistice. The GIA leader returned to his country. Waving the peace agreement on the spaceship's steps, he declared another victory for the great Galaxy Interstellar Alliance. But aside from pre-arranged personnel around the ship and applause from behind-the-scenes capitalists, the bottom people and weary middle class watching behind broadcasts and screens only sighed and returned to their daily routines. The Liberatio Gentis leader shouted from the podium about the so-called "independence" of the "motherland." He loudly proclaimed victory for the "Superior Golden Glorias Race" over those Golden Glorias who mingled with "Inferior Races". Then, he left the podium, returned to his splendid prime ministerial residence, opened a bottle of GIA "aid" champagne, and laughed in merriment, heedless of the people's bones buried beneath the glittering residence. Golden Glorias pioneers watching the speech of the "Great Leader" on screens only gripped their pendants, lamenting that they might never reunite with family. The UPR Supreme Council informed their people that the "peace agreement" had been signed, general mobilisation would cease, and life could return to normal. But the Supreme Military Command was not dissolved, military training and reform continued, and arsenals did not halt production. Reconstruction began, but all in the UPR simmered with anger, like oppressive weather before a storm, hiding terrifying fury. The war ended. In this great war lasting 49 years, tens of millions were displaced, countless separated from loved ones, and trillions in economic value lost. Yet, this was not the end. The UPR began reconstruction and started expanding into the rimworlds. The Galaxy Interstellar Alliance, however, fared worse. Years after the war, the GIA still could not shake off the war's immense impact. Finally, a bank run triggered a massive economic crisis that swept through the GIA. Countless investments vanished like stones in the sea. The crisis severely damaged the GIA's overall strength. Protests, demonstrations, and even revolts became common. Though the GIA suppressed them barely, its decline was visible to all. No matter how many times the Liberatio Gentis leader touted "independence", he could not deny that Liberatio Gentis was merely an GIA client state. The economic crisis affected them too, and aid and investment from the GIA sharply decreased. The GIA dared not imagine the hungry dog turning on themselves. The UPR, with its unique economic system, remained unaffected by the crisis. Watching the GIA and its puppet struggle in the flood, the UPR's expansion accelerated, reconstruction largely completed, and technology leapt forward, even gradually surpassing the GIA. Meanwhile, something seemingly insignificant happened on the UPR homeworld: excavations of former civilisation ruins yielded interesting progress. A Glorias database was unearthed, revealing to the UPR that their greatest enemy had not fought them for the first time…… Twenty years after the war, the economic crisis's aftershocks lingered. The GIA and Liberatio Gentis remained mired, whilst the UPR developed at an unprecedented pace. The GIA's upper class schemed for blood-stained power. GIA's economists headaches over appalling reports. The middle class could only dream of returning to prosperity built on people's sweat and blood. The bottom people, however, either lay on cold ground forever closing their eyes, eked out a living in factories working multiples harder for a meal, or took up arms to charge the greedy upper class. The Liberatio Gentis leader still used media to deceive, pretending all was normal. Liberatio Gentis generals embezzled the paltry GIA aid, exploiting the bottom people's sweat for villas and luxury cars. The leader would not reprimand them— he was one of them. The bottom people could only close their eyes on cold beds, perhaps forever, with their last thoughts of hometown and loved ones. The UPR Supreme Council continued another development plan. The Supreme Command drafted new military strategies. The Minister of UPR Internal Affairs, Hebrew Phoenix, signed a spy list from Liberatio Gentis with red characters. The SSRB welcomed its new director, Albert Sardior, continuing the previous important research on "Archo Intelligence". The UPR people strove for their perhaps imperfect nation. And within the Contemplation System, a faintly visible figure watched the prosperous motherland and smiled. The players have taken their seats; a new game will soon begin. And as three unfortunate Golden Glorias pioneers fall into the rimworld due to an accident, the era will continue to unfold. In the forges' hammer sparks, in the rebels' gunfire, in the night workers' shadow under streetlights, upon the boundless starry sea, a tall figure seems to stand. He gazes with transcendent vision at this starry expanse full of iron and blood, sweat and tears.There are the memories of billions of souls, the history of countless people, and the story in his eyes. He firmly extends his intangible, yet powerful hands, and begins composing the next chapter of destiny. Hōra est! Īte! Fātum tuum regite!
LanguageData.GG_Mora_Gene.Page2Content: Future Development Plans (Ambitious Roadmap): Automated Industrialisation System: A comprehensive and powerful industrial system that transforms your colony management into building a veritable industrial city. Golden Glorias Superpowers and Psycasts: Dozens of unique abilities and psycasts that can alter battlefield dynamics through strategic combinations or create formidable one-person armies. Antiquated Foes: A powerful faction lurking in the depths of space, watching your colony with predatory intent— seeking only to obliterate everything you've built. Main Storyline: "You're right, but Golden Glorias - Golden Future is a RimWorld Mod developed by 妄想索赛罗." Explore and uncover the true origins of the Golden Glorias, potentially even altering their destiny. Weapon Overhaul: A more rational and realistic weapons technology tree aligning closer to real-world principles.
